description:
Manage Focus ai with the following actions:

- **accept-ai-change**: Accept Ai Change Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*, view_id*)
- **apply-ai-change**: Apply Ai Change Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*, view_id*)
- **connect-ai-source**: Connect Ai Source Ai. (data: payload*{redirect_uri*}, source_id*)
- **day-rebuild-group**: Day Rebuild Group Ai. (data: payload*{evidence*})
- **day-rebuild-name**: Day Rebuild Name Ai. (data: payload*{evidence*})
- **day-rebuild-projects**: Day Rebuild Projects Ai. (data: payload*{evidence*})
- **day-rebuild-read-connected**: Day Rebuild Read Connected Ai. (data: payload*{now*, service*, since*, tools*, final, preferred_tools, turns})
- **discard-ai-change**: Discard Ai Change Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*, view_id*)
- **disconnect-ai-source**: Disconnect Ai Source Ai. (data: source_id*)
- **finish-ai-source**: Finish Ai Source Ai. (data: payload*{code*, state*}, source_id*)
- **get-conversations**: Get Conversations Ai. (data: before, limit, search)
- **get-messages**: Get Messages Ai. (data: conversation_id*, limit)
- **get-sources**: Get Sources Ai. (data: none)
- **next-ai-actions**: Next Ai Actions Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*)
- **remove-ai-attachment**: Remove Ai Attachment Ai. (data: attachment_id*, conversation_id*)
- **run-ai-view**: Run Ai View Ai. (data: payload*{input*, tool*})
- **search**: Search Ai. (data: q*)
- **send-ai-message**: Send Ai Message Ai. (data: conversation_id*, payload*{text*, attachment_ids, page_context})
- **undo-ai-change**: Undo Ai Change Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*, view_id*)
- **upload-ai-attachment**: Upload Ai Attachment Ai. (data: conversation_id*, file*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: accept-ai-change, apply-ai-change, connect-ai-source, day-rebuild-group, day-rebuild-name, day-rebuild-projects, day-rebuild-read-connected, discard-ai-change, disconnect-ai-source, finish-ai-source, get-conversations, get-messages, get-sources, next-ai-actions, remove-ai-attachment, run-ai-view, search, send-ai-message, undo-ai-change, upload-ai-attachment

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
